cues.en: Transcriber: Denise RQ Reviewer: CN R
571,230,000 pounds of paper towels
are used by Americans every year.

cues.zh: 如果我们可以——更正，数字错了。
cues.en: If we could -- correction, wrong figure.
13 billion used every year.

cues.zh: 如果我们能减少纸巾的使用量，
cues.en: If we could reduce the usage of paper towels,

cues.zh: 每人每天少用一张纸巾，
cues.en: one paper towel per person per day,
571,230,000 pounds of paper not used.
We could do that.

cues.zh: 现在有各种各样的纸巾分配器。
cues.en: Now there are all kinds of paper towel dispensers.
There's the trifold.
People typically take two or three.
There's the one that cuts it --
that you have to tear off.

cues.zh: 人们一、二、三、四地撕。这么多，对吧。
cues.en: People go one, two, three, four tear. This much, right.
There's the one that cuts itself.
People go one, two, three, four.

cues.zh: 或者同样的东西，但用的是再生纸。
cues.en: Or there's the same thing but recycled paper.
You have to get five of those

cues.zh: 因为吸水性当然没那么好。
cues.en: because they're not as absorbent of course.
(Laughter)

cues.zh: 事实是，一条毛巾就能搞定一切。
cues.en: The fact is you can do it all with one towel.
The key, two words.

cues.zh: 这半边房间，你们的词是“甩”。
cues.en: This half of the room your word is 'shake.'
Let's hear it, 'shake.'
(Audience) Shake. Joe Smith: Louder.
(Audience) Shake.
Your word is 'fold.'
(Audience) Fold. JS: Again.
(Audience) Fold. JS: Really loud.
(Audience) Shake. (Audience) Fold.
OK. (Laughter) Wet hands.

cues.zh: 甩。一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十、十一、十二。
cues.en: Shake. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven, twelve.

cues.zh: 为什么是12？12使徒。12支派。12星座。12个月。
cues.en: Why 12? 12 apostles. 12 tribes. 12 zodiac signs. 12 months.

cues.zh: 我最喜欢的是，它是单音节里最大的数字。
cues.en: The one I like the best it's the biggest number with one syllable.
(Laughter)
Trifold.
(Applause)
Fold.
Dry.
(Applause)
(Audience) Shake.
(Audience) Fold.
Cuts itself. Fold.

cues.zh: 折很重要，因为它能实现
cues.en: The fold is important because it allows
interstitial suspension.

cues.zh: 这部分你不用记住，但相信我。
cues.en: You don't have to remember that part but trust me.
(Laughter)
(Audience) Shake.
(Audience) Fold.
Cuts itself.

cues.zh: 有趣的是，我的手比那些用三四张纸的人还干
cues.en: The funny thing is I get my hands drier than people do with three or four

cues.zh: 因为他们擦不到指缝里。
cues.en: because they can't get in between the cracks.

cues.zh: 如果你觉得这还不够好。
cues.en: If you think this isn't as good.
(Audience) Shake.
(Audience) Fold.

cues.zh: 现在有个真正花哨的发明。
cues.en: Now, there's now a real fancy invention.

cues.zh: 就是你挥一下手，它就弹出来。
cues.en: It's the one where you wave your hand and it kicks it out.
It's was too big a towel.

cues.zh: 告诉你个秘密，如果你动作够快，
cues.en: Let me tell you a secret if you're really quick,

cues.zh: 如果你动作真的够快，我能证明……
cues.en: if you're really quick and I can prove this...

cues.zh: 这是这栋楼里出纸机的一半毛巾。
cues.en: This is half a towel from the dispenser in this building.

cues.zh: 怎么做到？它一开始出纸你就直接撕下来。
cues.en: How? As soon as it starts you just tear it off.

cues.zh: 它够聪明会停下来，你就得到半张毛巾。
cues.en: It's smart enough to stop and you get half a towel.
(Laughter)
(Audience) Shake.
(Audience) Fold.
Now let's all say it together.
(Audience) & JS: Shake.
(Audience) & JS: Fold.
You will for the rest of your life

cues.zh: 每次拿起纸巾时想起这句话。
cues.en: remember those words every time you pick up a paper towel.

cues.zh: 记住：每人每年一张纸巾。
cues.en: And remember: one towel per person for one year.
571,230,000 pounds of paper.
No small thing. And next year, toilet paper.
(Laughter)
